title: The effect of intrinsic image memorability on recollection and familiarity
caption_short: Experiment 2 trial sequence. Encoding: fixation 1 s, then a scene for 2 s. Test: fixation 1 s, scene 2 s, then a six-point old / new confidence judgement, a remember / know (or detailed-new / unknown) judgement, and feedback.
